collection.description: An elder teaches how to observe delicate wings without touching them.

e1.name: Ending 1
e1.text: (Name1), an elder, teaches how to observe delicate wings without touching them. Someone sketches the colors before forgetting them.

e2.name: Ending 2
e2.text: (Name1), an elder, teaches how to observe delicate wings without touching them. The group stays a little longer, hoping to see another species.

e3.name: Ending 3
e3.text: (Name1), an elder, teaches how to observe delicate wings without touching them. The butterfly is gently released after everyone has looked.

e4__fx.name: Ending 4
e4__fx.text: (Name1), an elder, teaches how to observe delicate wings without touching them. (Name1) is amazed by a pattern almost invisible from afar.
